description.zh:
聚合器。可以使用一个或多个聚合器查询实例聚合信息。
取值范围：
- ACS:Application.Name
- ACS:Application.Version
description.en:
The aggregator. You can use one or more aggregators to query aggregated information about instances.
Valid values:

- ACS:Application.Name

- ACS:Application.Version
The filter rules for the component.

description.zh: 组件的属性名称(N取值范围1-5)。不同的组件内部属性的名称不同。使用[GetInventorySchema](https://api.aliyun.com/#/?product=oos&version=2019-06-01&api=GetInventorySchema)查询不同组件的属性名称。例如：组件ACS:InstanceInformation下有InstanceId这个属性，所以本参数则取值为ACS:InstanceInformation.InstanceId。
description.en: The name of the component property. You can specify up to five filters. Property names vary for different components. Call the [GetInventorySchema](https://api.aliyun.com/#/?product=oos\&version=2019-06-01\&api=GetInventorySchema) operation to query the property names of different components. For example, the ACS:InstanceInformation component has the InstanceId property. For this component, set this parameter to ACS:InstanceInformation.InstanceId.

description.zh:
组件属性查询值比较符(N取值范围1-5)。
取值范围：
- Equal
- NotEqual
- BeginWith
- LessThan
- GreaterThan
description.en:
The comparison operator for the property value. You can specify up to five filters.
Valid values:

- Equal

- NotEqual

- BeginWith

- LessThan

- GreaterThan
A list of values for the component property query.

description.zh: 分页大小。取值范围：1-100。默认为50。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 50.
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results.

title.zh: 查询配置清单的详细信息或聚合信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos search-inventory --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token gAAAAABfTgv5ewUWmNdJ3g7JVLvX70sPH90GZOVGC --max-results 50 --filter '[{"Operator":"Equal","Value":["i-bp1cpoxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"],"Name":"ACS:InstanceInformation.InstanceId"}]' --aggregator ACS:Application.Name --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos SearchInventory --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken gAAAAABfTgv5ewUWmNdJ3g7JVLvX70sPH90GZOVGC --Filter.1.Value.1 'i-bp1cpoxxxxxxxxxxxxxx' --Aggregator.1 'ACS:Application.Name' --MaxResults 50 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Filter.1.Operator Equal --Filter.1.Name 'ACS:InstanceInformation.InstanceId'
